law.description: rate law kind: spin, move, orbit, grow, fade, align, follow, stretch, keys

at.description: start tick of the law's window (ticks since the instance started)

every.description: repeat period in ticks, or {from, to, ease}

times.description: with every: maximum occurrences in time; without every: a family of N simultaneous instances id[i]

ease.description: shapes the accumulated TOTAL over the window (ADR-0303 3.7); absent = linear

to.description: opacity at the end

law.description: rate law kind: spin, move, orbit, grow, fade, align, follow, stretch, keys

forward.description: blocks along the frame's forward axis

up.description: blocks along the frame's up axis

left.description: blocks along the frame's left axis

axis.description: forward|back|up|down|left|right|long|edge|face, optionally '<frame>.' prefixed and '-' negated

deg.description: degrees about the axis; +deg carries the basis axes forward -> left -> up -> forward (+deg about up carries forward toward left); a swing direction is not written with this, see RigSwings

forward.description: blocks along the frame's forward axis

up.description: blocks along the frame's up axis

color.description: absolute colour #rrggbb of a text / sprite display (lerped per channel)
